prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it and do task. If object is visible, move to object, check object properties, else wander. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = WanderRandomly    /> <Action ID = DoTask    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO DoTask
	END
